data.name: Ota.Tips
data.value: How to: 1. Pick the 5-key firmware for a 5-key pad, or the 4-key firmware for a 4-key pad 2. Keep USB connected; do not unplug, power off or close this window while upgrading 3. On failure the board stays in Bootloader - just retry. ISP: the 5-key image, the 4-key image, or stock V2.13 only

data.name: Ota.SelectPrompt
data.value: Select a firmware .bin, then start the upgrade.

data.name: Ota.SizeWarn
data.value:
This image is longer than the stock image ({0} > {1} bytes).
This OTA window writes the whole image and is normally fine. If you use the vendor ISP/IPS tool instead: flash the 5-key image, the 4-key image, or stock V2.13 at 0x08004000, otherwise the tail may be truncated and USB will stop enumerating.

data.name: Ota.V.TooSmall
data.value: Firmware too small (<{0}); rejected to avoid writing an invalid image.

data.name: Ota.V.TooLarge
data.value: Firmware too large (>{0}); it would overwrite the config area. Rejected to prevent bricking.

data.name: Ota.V.BadSp
data.value: Vector table stack pointer is not in SRAM; this is probably not an APP image for this board. Rejected.

data.name: Ota.V.BadReset
data.value: Reset vector is outside the APP region (0x08004000~0x0800F800). Rejected to prevent bricking.

data.name: Ota.V.BadUsbVector
data.value: USB interrupt vector (0x14C) of this image has been overwritten. Rejected. Use the 5-key image, the 4-key image, or stock V2.13.
